latestAction.text: The Chair announced that the message and the accompanying bill would be referred to the Committees on Energy and Commerce and Ways and Means and that the Clerk would be directed to notify the Senate of the actions of the House.

notes.text: As passed in the House, H.R. 976 was the Small Business Tax Relief Act of 2007. In the Senate, text similar to S. 1893, the Children's Health Insurance Program Reauthorization Act of 2007, was substituted in H.R. 976. As sent to the President, H.R. 976 was the Children's Health Insurance Program Reauthorization Act of 2007.
